workflows.name: Register video clip
steps: read and bound the uploaded AVI payload
parse RIFF geometry and frame offsets
atomically commit clip bytes and metadata
workflows.success: returns a registered clip whose digest and geometry describe the stored bytes
workflows.failure: returns a stable validation or conflict error without a visible partial clip
workflows.verification: the clip intake smoke path uploads generated AVI footage, reads the record, and rejects a truncated payload

workflows.name: Index shot boundaries
steps: create and transition an inspection job
decode sampled frames and compute fingerprints
persist contiguous scenes and representative frames
workflows.success: returns an indexed inspection with complete ordered scene ranges
workflows.failure: returns a failed inspection with no partial successful scene index
workflows.verification: the scene indexing smoke path detects all generated scene changes and verifies the terminal job state

workflows.name: Create contact sheet
steps: decode representative frames and compose fixed-size tiles
commit the PPM payload and matching tile map
workflows.success: returns a ready contact sheet whose digest and dimensions match the artifact
workflows.failure: rejects an oversized grid without exposing a visible partial artifact
workflows.verification: the contact sheet smoke path fetches the PPM artifact and confirms the committed layout and representative scenes
